description: A wide 16:9 concept diagram explaining query, key and value in attention, read left to right. On the LEFT, one rounded tile with a sky-blue outline labelled 'the last position' with a small grey caption 'about to write the answer'. Attached to it, a small sky-blue card labelled 'Query' with the grey line 'what am I looking for?' and inside it the text 'a place, and the item'. In the MIDDLE, a vertical column of four rounded white tiles labelled, top to bottom, 'battery', 'packs', 'Manchester', 'stores'. Each tile has two small cards attached to its right side: a green-outlined card labelled 'Key' with a grey line ('an item', 'an item', 'a place', 'a place, partly' respectively) and a white card labelled 'Value' with a grey line 'what it passes on'. From the Query card, four lines fan out to the four Key cards; the line to 'Manchester' is the thickest and darkest sky blue, the lines to 'battery' and 'stores' are medium, the line to 'packs' is thin; each line is labelled with a small number: battery 0.14, packs 0.07, Manchester 0.59, stores 0.20. On the RIGHT, the four Value cards feed arrows into one rounded sky-blue box labelled 'New vector for the last position' with the grey caption 'mostly what Manchester passes on'. Along the bottom, one thin line of text centered: 'match the query with every key, turn the matches into weights, mix the values by those weights'. Labels as plain text, no brackets, spelled exactly as given, no other text.
